note: Gross purchases ~$1.75tn ($1.25tn MBS + $200bn agency debt + $300bn Treasuries); balance sheet ~$0.9tn->$2.3tn (net +~$1.4tn). 10y yield effect: Krishnamurthy-Vissing-Jorgensen (2011) ~-107bp; Gagnon et al. (2011) ~-91bp on the 10y (LSAP event study). Representative -100bp; range -80 to -120bp. LARGEST per-dollar effect — worked partly via crisis/safety premium in dysfunctional markets. [SOURCED]

$600bn long-term Treasuries; balance sheet ->~$2.9tn. 10y effect much smaller in functioning markets: KVJ ~-18bp (10y, safe-asset channel); Gagnon-type ~-15 to -20bp per $500bn. Representative -20bp; range -15 to -30bp. First clear sign of DIMINISHING returns vs QE1. [SOURCED]

Maturity Extension Program: sold ~$667bn short-dated Treasuries, bought equal long-dated -> NO balance-sheet expansion (duration-only 'twist'). 10y effect via term-premium/duration channel ~-15bp; range -10 to -25bp. Shows the portfolio-balance/duration channel operating without new reserves. [SOURCED size; ESTIMATED yield]

Open-ended flow: $85bn/mo ($40bn MBS + $45bn Treasuries), ~$1.6tn total; balance sheet ~$2.8tn->$4.5tn (net +~$1.7tn). Announcement effect small/hard to isolate (flow- vs stock-based, pre-anticipated); estimates ~-20 to -50bp. Representative -30bp. 'Taper tantrum' May-2013 reversed some as exit was priced. Diminishing announcement returns continue. [SOURCED size; ESTIMATED yield]

~$4.6-4.7tn purchases ($120bn/mo: $80bn Treasuries + $40bn MBS); balance sheet ~$4.2tn->$8.9tn (peak ~$9.0tn May-2022, ~35% of GDP). Initial purpose = restore Mar-2020 Treasury-market functioning; later pure stimulus. Yield effect hard to isolate (rates already ~0); crisis compression est. -100 to -150bp initially, persistent effect smaller. Representative -100bp; wide range. Followed by 2021-22 inflation surge. [SOURCED size; ESTIMATED yield]

First quantitative tightening: passive roll-off, balance sheet ~$4.5tn->$3.8tn (net -~$0.7tn). Upward 10y pressure modest, ~+10 to +25bp (term-premium add-back). Representative +15bp. 'On autopilot'; ended early after Sep-2019 repo-market spike (reserve scarcity). [SOURCED size; ESTIMATED yield]

Largest QT ever, alongside +525bp of hikes: caps up to $95bn/mo (later tapered), balance sheet ~$8.9tn->~$6.6tn by mid-2026 (net -~$2.3tn, ongoing). Term-premium/yield add estimated small and gradual, ~+10 to +50bp cumulative. Representative +30bp. Ongoing as of compile date. [SOURCED size; ESTIMATED yield]
